en.text: After Abimelech, Tola the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, arose to save Israel. He lived in Shamir in the hill country of Ephraim.

zhSimplified.text: 亚比米勒以后，有以萨迦人朵多的孙子、普瓦的儿子陀拉兴起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法莲山地的沙密。

zhTraditional.text: 亞比米勒以後，有以薩迦人朵多的孫子、普瓦的兒子陀拉興起，拯救以色列人。他住在以法蓮山地的沙密。

en.text: He judged Israel twenty-three years, and died, and was buried in Shamir.

zhSimplified.text: 陀拉作以色列的士师二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。

zhTraditional.text: 陀拉作以色列的士師二十三年，就死了，葬在沙密。

en.text: After him Jair, the Gileadite, arose. He judged Israel twenty-two years.

zhSimplified.text: 在他以后有基列人睚珥兴起，作以色列的士师二十二年。

zhTraditional.text: 在他以後有基列人睚珥興起，作以色列的士師二十二年。

en.text: He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day, which are in the land of Gilead.

zhSimplified.text: 他有三十个儿子，骑着三十匹驴驹。他们有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特·睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。

zhTraditional.text: 他有三十個兒子，騎着三十匹驢駒。他們有三十座城邑，叫作哈倭特‧睚珥，直到如今，都是在基列地。

en.text: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.

The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人又行耶和华眼中看为恶的事，去事奉诸巴力和亚斯她录，并亚兰的神、西顿的神、摩押的神、亚扪人的神、非利士人的神，离弃耶和华，不事奉他。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人又行耶和華眼中看為惡的事，去事奉諸巴力和亞斯她錄，並亞蘭的神、西頓的神、摩押的神、亞捫人的神、非利士人的神，離棄耶和華，不事奉他。

en.text: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的怒气向以色列人发作，就把他们交在非利士人和亚扪人的手中。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的怒氣向以色列人發作，就把他們交在非利士人和亞捫人的手中。

en.text: They troubled and oppressed the children of Israel that year. For eighteen years they oppressed all the children of Israel that were beyond the Jordan in the land of the Amorites, which is in Gilead.

zhSimplified.text: 从那年起，他们扰害欺压约旦河那边、住亚摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。

zhTraditional.text: 從那年起，他們擾害欺壓約旦河那邊、住亞摩利人之基列地的以色列人，共有十八年。

en.text: The children of Ammon passed over the Jordan to fight also against Judah, and against Benjamin, and against the house of Ephraim, so that Israel was very distressed.

zhSimplified.text: 亚扪人又渡过约旦河去攻打犹大和便雅悯，并以法莲族。以色列人就甚觉窘迫。

zhTraditional.text: 亞捫人又渡過約旦河去攻打猶大和便雅憫，並以法蓮族。以色列人就甚覺窘迫。

en.text: The children of Israel cried to the LORD, saying, “We have sinned against you, even because we have forsaken our God, and have served the Baals.”

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人哀求耶和华说：「我们得罪了你；因为离弃了我们 神，去事奉诸巴力。」

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人哀求耶和華說：「我們得罪了你；因為離棄了我們上帝，去事奉諸巴力。」

en.text: The LORD said to the children of Israel, “Didn’t I save you from the Egyptians, and from the Amorites, from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华对以色列人说：「我岂没有救过你们脱离埃及人、亚摩利人、亚扪人，和非利士人吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華對以色列人說：「我豈沒有救過你們脫離埃及人、亞摩利人、亞捫人，和非利士人嗎？

en.text: The Sidonians also, and the Amalekites, and the Maonites, oppressed you; and you cried to me, and I saved you out of their hand.

zhSimplified.text: 西顿人、亚玛力人、马云人也都欺压你们；你们哀求我，我也拯救你们脱离他们的手。

zhTraditional.text: 西頓人、亞瑪力人、馬雲人也都欺壓你們；你們哀求我，我也拯救你們脫離他們的手。

en.text: Yet you have forsaken me and served other gods. Therefore I will save you no more.

zhSimplified.text: 你们竟离弃我，事奉别神！所以我不再救你们了。

zhTraditional.text: 你們竟離棄我，事奉別神！所以我不再救你們了。

en.text: Go and cry to the gods which you have chosen. Let them save you in the time of your distress!”

zhSimplified.text: 你们去哀求所选择的神；你们遭遇急难的时候，让他救你们吧！」

zhTraditional.text: 你們去哀求所選擇的神；你們遭遇急難的時候，讓他救你們吧！」

en.text: The children of Israel said to the LORD, “We have sinned! Do to us whatever seems good to you; only deliver us, please, today.”

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人对耶和华说：「我们犯罪了，任凭你随意待我们吧！只求你今日拯救我们。」

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人對耶和華說：「我們犯罪了，任憑你隨意待我們吧！只求你今日拯救我們。」

en.text: They put away the foreign gods from among them and served the LORD; and his soul was grieved for the misery of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 以色列人就除掉他们中间的外邦神，事奉耶和华。耶和华因以色列人受的苦难，就心中担忧。

zhTraditional.text: 以色列人就除掉他們中間的外邦神，事奉耶和華。耶和華因以色列人受的苦難，就心中擔憂。

en.text: Then the children of Ammon were gathered together and encamped in Gilead. The children of Israel assembled themselves together and encamped in Mizpah.

zhSimplified.text: 当时亚扪人聚集，安营在基列。以色列人也聚集，安营在米斯巴。

zhTraditional.text: 當時亞捫人聚集，安營在基列。以色列人也聚集，安營在米斯巴。

en.text: The people, the princes of Gilead, said to one another, “Who is the man who will begin to fight against the children of Ammon? He shall be head over all the inhabitants of Gilead.”

zhSimplified.text: 基列的民和众首领彼此商议说：「谁能先去攻打亚扪人，谁必作基列一切居民的领袖。」

zhTraditional.text: 基列的民和眾首領彼此商議說：「誰能先去攻打亞捫人，誰必作基列一切居民的領袖。」
